name: detect_ats_adp_workforcenow_full_url
spec_quote: adp: `workforcenow.adp.com/mascsr/default/mdf/recruitment/recruitment.html?<query>` (also `workforcenow.cloud.adp.com`) → that whole host + path + query, lower-cased

name: detect_ats_paycom_portal_token_strips_tail
spec_quote: paycom: `paycomonline.net/v4/ats/web.php/portal/<32 hex>` (or `/jobs/<32 hex>`) → "paycomonline.net/v4/ats/web.php/portal/<token>" (the part after the token is dropped)

name: detect_ats_paylocity_jobs_all_guid
spec_quote: paylocity: `recruiting.paylocity.com/Recruiting/Jobs/All/<GUID>` (or `/List/`) → lower-cased host + path; else "recruiting.paylocity.com".

name: detect_ats_dayforce_with_locale
spec_quote: dayforce: `jobs.dayforcehcm.com/[<locale like en-US>/]<tenant>[/<board>]` → host + those path parts, lower-cased.

name: detect_ats_brassring_query_with_partnerid
spec_quote: brassring: a `jobs.` / `sjobs.` / `ts.brassring.com` URL whose query has `partnerid=` → host + path + query (lower-cased); else the host.

name: detect_ats_clearcompany_slug
spec_quote: clearcompany: `apply.clearcompany.com/<slug>` → "apply.clearcompany.com/<slug>"; `<x>.hrmdirect.com` → that host; a bare `apply.clearcompany.com` → "apply.clearcompany.com".

name: clean_ident_adp_amp_entity_decoded
spec_quote: adp: HTML entities in the ident are decoded twice ("&", "&"), anything after "#" dropped, query keys compared case-insensitively. ... `cid` must be 36 characters of hex digits and dashes; `ccId` must be 8 digits, "_", 6 digits. → "<host>/<cid>/<ccid>".

name: clean_ident_adp_missing_ccid_null
spec_quote: Otherwise null (a bare host, a `myjobs.adp.com/<slug>` ident, a missing ccId).

name: clean_ident_brassring_numeric_entity
spec_quote: brassring: host `jobs.` / `sjobs.` / `ts.brassring.com`; `partnerid` and `siteid` in the query, both digits only (entities decoded, "#…" dropped) → "<host>/<partnerid>/<siteid>"; else null.

name: clean_ident_paycom_portal_token
spec_quote: paycom: the ident must end in `/portal/<32 hex>` or `/jobs/<32 hex>` → the 32-hex token; else null.

name: clean_ident_paylocity_guid
spec_quote: paylocity: must end in `/recruiting/jobs/all/<GUID>` or `/list/<GUID>` (GUID = 8-4-4-4-12 hex) → the GUID; else null.

name: clean_ident_dayforce_with_locale
spec_quote: dayforce: path after the host, split on "/"; a leading locale ("en-us", "fr") is dropped only when three parts remain; exactly two parts left and the second is not "jobs" → "<tenant>/<board>"; else null

name: clean_ident_dayforce_no_locale
spec_quote: dayforce: path after the host, split on "/"; a leading locale ("en-us", "fr") is dropped only when three parts remain; exactly two parts left and the second is not "jobs" → "<tenant>/<board>"; else null

name: clean_ident_dayforce_locale_only_null
spec_quote: exactly two parts left and the second is not "jobs" → "<tenant>/<board>"; else null ("jobs.dayforcehcm.com/en-us" → null).

name: clean_ident_clearcompany_bare_host_null
spec_quote: clearcompany: `apply.clearcompany.com/<slug>` (slug not vendor infrastructure and not "v1") or `<x>.hrmdirect.com` → kept as is; a bare `apply.clearcompany.com` → null.

name: parse_adp_basic_single_location_empty_dropped
spec_quote: parse_adp(d, host, cid, ccid): d.jobRequisitions[] with itemID → title = requisitionTitle; location = requisitionLocations[].nameCode.shortName joined with "; " (empty ones dropped); url = `https://<host>/mascsr/default/mdf/recruitment/recruitment.html?cid=<cid>&ccId=<ccid>&lang=en_US&jobId=<itemID>&source=CC2` ... Rows that are not objects or lack itemID are skipped.

name: parse_adp_multi_location_and_non_object_row
spec_quote: location = requisitionLocations[].nameCode.shortName joined with "; " (empty ones dropped) ... Rows that are not objects or lack itemID are skipped.

name: paycom_config_good_trailing_slash_removed
spec_quote: paycom_config(page) → [jwt, service_url] or null: reads the JSON between `var configsFromHost = ` and `; var Mountable`; needs sessionJWT and libConfig (a JSON string) with atsPortalMantleServiceUrl; the service URL must be https, its host paycomonline.net or a subdomain of it ... a trailing "/" is removed.

name: paycom_config_foreign_service_host_null
spec_quote: the service URL must be https, its host paycomonline.net or a subdomain of it, with no query, fragment, user name or port other than 443 ... Anything else → null.

name: paycom_config_missing_libconfig_null
spec_quote: needs sessionJWT and libConfig (a JSON string) with atsPortalMantleServiceUrl ... Anything else → null.

name: parse_paylocity_internal_job_skipped
spec_quote: parse_paylocity(page): JSON after `window.pageData = `; Jobs[] that are objects, have JobId and are not IsInternal → title JobTitle; location = JobLocation.City and .State joined ", ", else LocationName, else ""; url = `https://recruiting.paylocity.com/Recruiting/Jobs/Details/<JobId>`.

name: parse_paylocity_locationname_fallback_and_missing_jobid
spec_quote: location = JobLocation.City and .State joined ", ", else LocationName, else "" ... Jobs[] that are objects, have JobId and are not IsInternal

name: parse_dayforce_uses_jobdetailsurl_on_exact_host
spec_quote: parse_dayforce(d, tenant, board): d must be a list; items with Title and ReferenceNumber; url = JobDetailsUrl when its host is exactly jobs.dayforcehcm.com, else `https://jobs.dayforcehcm.com/en-US/<tenant>/<board>/jobs/<ReferenceNumber>`; location = City, State joined ", ".

name: parse_dayforce_foreign_jobdetailsurl_falls_back
spec_quote: url = JobDetailsUrl when its host is exactly jobs.dayforcehcm.com, else `https://jobs.dayforcehcm.com/en-US/<tenant>/<board>/jobs/<ReferenceNumber>`

name: brassring_session_token_and_entity_decoded_cookie

args.page: <form><input type="hidden" name="__RequestVerificationToken" value="tok123" /><input type="hidden" id="CookieValue" value="cv&42" /></form>

spec_quote: brassring_session(page) → [token, cookie_value] or null: token = value of the hidden input named `__RequestVerificationToken`; cookie_value = value of the hidden input with id `CookieValue`, HTML entities decoded. Both needed.

name: brassring_session_missing_cookievalue_null
spec_quote: Both needed.

name: parse_brassring_location_question_and_link
spec_quote: parse_brassring(d): d.Jobs.Job[]; Questions[] become {QuestionName lower-cased: Value}; title = jobtitle; location = the first non-empty value whose name contains "location" or "city" (tags removed), else ""; url = Link; jobs without a title or Link are skipped.

name: parse_brassring_skips_jobs_without_link_and_defaults_location
spec_quote: location = the first non-empty value whose name contains "location" or "city" (tags removed), else ""; url = Link; jobs without a title or Link are skipped.

name: clearcompany_site_id_guid
spec_quote: clearcompany_site_id(page) → the `data-site-id="<36-char GUID>"` value, else null.

name: parse_clearcompany_filters_and_strips_apply
spec_quote: parse_clearcompany(d): d.results[] → title positionTitle, location `location` (or ""), url = applyLink with a trailing "/apply" removed; kept only when there is a title and the url starts with https://.
